1. (a) Roughly spherical blob, no clear upright bundle — orientation ambiguous, effectively lying/round rather than standing; (b) sponge/hollow with many holes; (c) no micelle belt visible; (d) no frames, render nearly touches edges but not cropped; (e) pure black background.

2. (a) Rounded/oblique blob, not upright; (b) solid but lumpy with small holes (sponge-like surface); (c) no micelle; (d) bottom slightly cut off at image edge; (e) black background.

3. (a) Long axis tilted/oblique (two lobes, diagonal arrangement); (b) reasonably solid, smooth; (c) second smaller blob to the right (possible micelle/aggregate); (d) left lobe touches left edge, slight cropping; (e) black.

4. (a) Lying-down, flattened wide blob (long axis horizontal); (b) very sponge/hollow, Swiss-cheese; (c) no distinct belt; (d) edges approach borders but no frame; (e) black.

5. (a) Round, no upright axis; (b) speckled/noisy with many disconnected fragments (over-sharpened); (c) none; (d) fragments nearly touch edges; (e) black.

6. (a) Round/undefined, not standing; (b) very speckled/fragmented noise; (c) none; (d) fragments touch top and left edges; (e) black.

7. (a) No coherent protein — scattered disconnected blobs; (b) fragmented/speckled, low-density; (c) none; (d) pieces approach edges; (e) black.

8. (a) Upright standing bundle, closest to a proper membrane side view; (b) solid but noisy/rugged surface with protrusions (slightly over-sharpened, not clean); (c) no clear gray micelle belt; (d) touches left/right edges, minor cropping; (e) black.
